title: Moda Express
summary: Moda Express is a 3PL running the Datex FootPrint WMS. Data is exchanged as XML files over SFTP: Moda Express drops inventory snapshots, shipping confirmations and warehouse receipts for you, and picks up the sales orders, returns and inbound shipments you send. Connect it to sync inventory, products, orders, shipments, returns and inbound shipments.
